QuestInfo.name: Movie Star
QuestInfo.0: I should talk to Furano, a world-famous movie director. I wonder what he's made? I hope it wasn't something awful, like 'Rampage of the Merciless Onions'...
QuestInfo.1: The final audition is pretty simple. I need to just take on #b#o6130101##k at the inner corner of Henesys. I'll have to destroy it at all costs! \n#o6130101#  #r#a80301##k
QuestInfo.2: No way, I'm in the movie already? Darn! No Makeup or anything! If I had known about this, then I would have at least tried to look a bit nicer. Anyways, I can't wait to see how my awesome array of skills comes out on film--maybe I'll even get a close-up!

0.0: Oh. You're the one Mariwaka was talking about. We don't need to discuss this any further; let's get straight to the final audition.

yes.0: This is a blockbuster action flick that features two main characters bravely standing up against a Mushmom that's harassing the citizens of Henesys, and eventually defeat it. Isn't that cool?
yes.1: I've decided not to use any stunt doubles for this flick, making it a fast, authentic, thrilling action flick for everyone to enjoy.
yes.2: You know what I'm talking about, right? Alright, the final audition is... defeat the menace of Henesys, Mushmom. Okay? Action!

no.0: Hey, what do you think you're doing? You're talking about turning down a starring role in a movie by the world-renowned Furano.
no.1: Once you're featured in my movie, your path to superstardom is pretty much clear. You must be cuckoo to reject that opportunity!
no.2: Well, you may not be ready to take on Mushmom right now, so if you change your mind, talk to me.

1.0: Hahaha, there was no need to rush back. I've already got all the footage I need! This wasn't an audition; I filmed it all for the movie, and it's in the can now! You were absolutely fantastic--the skill, speed! It was an honor to film you. Don't worry, you'll be credited as 'J. Doe', doesn't that sound great? You'll be a big star!
1.1: Thanks to your help, this is going to be a fantastic movie. Yes, yes, yes, here's your movie guarantee. The movie should be out soon, so wish us luck!

mob.0: Hey! You haven't defeated #b#o6130101##k yet. If you can't nail the audition, I'm not putting you in my movie! *Shakes head* I only film authentic! No special effects.
